title: TracerouteResult
description: Schema definition for multi-hop visual traceroute and real-time MTR diagnostic results.

target.description: Target hostname or IP address provided for route discovery.

resolvedIp.description: Target destination IP address resolved via DNS.

protocol.description: Transport protocol utilized for probe packets.

mode.description: Operational mode: standard single-pass Traceroute or continuous MTR.

startTime.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when trace began.

endTime.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when trace completed or aborted.

status.description: Execution status of the trace session.

hops.description: Sequential array of discovered hop telemetry records ordered by TTL.

ip.description: Discovered router IP address at this hop, or null if firewalled.

hostname.description: Reverse DNS (PTR) hostname for this router node.

asn.description: Autonomous System Number for the hop IP.

country.description: Country where router hop is physically located.

city.description: City or metro area where router hop is located.

lossPercent.description: Packet loss percentage calculated over all probe cycles.

sent.description: Total probe packets transmitted to this hop.

received.description: Total ICMP response packets received from this hop.

rttLast.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds of most recent probe.

rttAvg.description: Average round-trip time in milliseconds across all probes.

rttBest.description: Lowest recorded round-trip time in milliseconds.

rttWorst.description: Highest recorded round-trip time in milliseconds.

rttStDev.description: Standard deviation of round-trip times in milliseconds.

probes.description: Detailed log of individual probe packets sent to this hop.

sequence.description: Probe sequence number within this TTL bucket.

rtt.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds if probe succeeded.
